demos.question: How many orders are in the database in total? Return an integer.
Total quantity sold all-time for the 'Pantry' reporting group as defined in the catalog. Return an integer.
demos.sql: SELECT SUM(od.Quantity) n FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID=p.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID=c.CategoryID WHERE c.CategoryName IN ('Grains/Cereals', 'Produce')
